issues.detail: Rule asserts start_shifting=0 in all non-FOUND states, but S01 only requires searching for 1101 and does not state the pre-detection output value; uncertain=false.
issues.spec_evidence: searches for the sequence 1101 in an input bit stream

issues.detail: Rule/reset object set start_shifting=0 under reset, but S03 only establishes active-high synchronous reset; it does not explicitly state the reset value.
Spec does not define detection-to-output latency; contract requires start_shifting visible on the completion posedge.
issues.spec_evidence: When the sequence is found, it should set start_shifting to 1
issues.alternative: start_shifting is registered and becomes 1 only at the next posedge after the completing 1101, not on the completion row.

issues.detail: Spec says forever until reset but does not define whether start_shifting clears while reset is high or on the first deasserted reset edge.
issues.alternative: Reset restarts the detector but start_shifting remains 1 while reset==1 and clears on the first posedge with reset==0.
